basic_attack.title: First Steps
lines: Tap your hero's card to attack the enemy with the target marker.
Every attack fills the BURST gauge. When the card glows, swipe up on it to unleash a Burst!

targeting.title: Choosing a Target
lines: Tap an enemy (or its plate at the top) to aim at it. The ember sigil marks your target.
Finish weakened foes first so fewer enemies can hit back.

elements.title: Elements
lines: Fire beats Nature, Nature beats Water, Water beats Fire.
ADVANTAGE hits deal 125% damage. Hitting a resistant foe deals 75% and shows RESIST.

waves.title: Waves
lines: Some stages have several waves. HP and Burst carry over between waves.
The wave counter at the top shows how many fights remain.

burst.title: Burst Timing
lines: Burst energy is gained by attacking and by taking damage. It carries between waves.
Holding a full Burst for a tough wave can turn the fight around.

guard.title: Guard
lines: Swipe DOWN on a hero card to Guard: half damage until your next turn, plus a little Burst.
Use it when an enemy is charging a big attack.

burn.title: Burn
lines: Burning units lose 5% of their max HP at the end of every turn.
Mira's Restoring Current can wash away a Burn.

boss.title: Mini-Boss
lines: The Ancient Bramble Pup calls its pack and hardens its bark when hurt.
Every few turns it CHARGES a rampage that hits the whole party - Guard when you see the warning!

healers.title: Enemy Healers
lines: Glowcaps mend their friends when they get hurt.
Defeat healers first, or their allies keep coming back.

buffs.title: Buffs
lines: Emberwisps fan their allies' flames: +ATK for a few turns.
Watch the status icons on each enemy plate. Tap and hold an icon to read it.

debuffs.title: Debuffs
lines: Hexmoths weaken your heroes with ATK Down and DEF Down.
Healers like Mira can wash negative statuses away.

elites.title: Elite Enemies
lines: ELITE enemies wear a gold frame. They are tougher, know one extra trick
and drop better materials.

shields.title: Shields
lines: Some enemies raise a Shield that absorbs damage before HP.
Break it with many hits - breakers and multi-hit heroes shine here.

charge.title: Charging Attacks
lines: When an enemy shows the CHARGING warning, its next move is a devastating attack.
Guard, heal or finish it off before it strikes!

boss2.title: The Saltglass Colossus
lines: The Colossus curses your armour and targets your weakest hero.
Below half HP it cracks open and hits much harder. Save a Burst for that moment.
